en.description: Turn a written civil-affairs materials list into one civil affairs voice clip per labeled cue. This materials list voice studio records each civil affairs instruction audio and window materials voice from the list the office already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 civil affairs voice pack files. Use it for civil affairs clip packs that keep one materials item on each clip.
en.summary: Turn a written civil-affairs materials list into one civil affairs voice clip per labeled cue.
en.title: Civil Affairs Voice: Materials-List Instruction Clips
